personality_one_liner: An immersive social micro-learning feed where trivia meets TikTok-style swiping, playful gamification, and peer-to-peer knowledge sharing.

spacing.rule: Generous playful touch targets, chunky rounded cards, and vertical breathing room with sticky bottom navigation and action sheets.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers, bottom navigation bar, and interactive floating action sheets over scrolling quiz feeds.
dont's: Never blur body text, quiz answer buttons, or dense form inputs.

screens.name: Feed
screens.purpose: Full-screen vertical swipeable TikTok-style quiz and micro-learning feed with multiple-choice options, instant feedback, and engagement action rail.

states.loading: Animated bouncy pulsing skeleton cards matching feed aspect ratios.
states.empty: Cheerful illustrated empty state with prompt to explore trending topics or create a new question.
states.error: Friendly error banner with retry button and offline cache indicator.

screens.layout: Vertical full-screen PagerView or FlatList with pagingEnabled. Each item displays a rich background visual with a gradient scrim, author badge, category pill, engaging question text, 4 tactile multiple-choice answer tiles, and a right-side floating action rail (like, comment sheet trigger, bookmark, share-to-friends modal trigger).

screens.name: CreateQuestion
screens.purpose: Allow users to author, format, and publish their own educational trivia questions to the global feed.

states.empty: Clean form with placeholders for question text, category, 4 options, and correct answer selection.
states.error: Validation error prompt highlighting missing fields.

screens.layout: Scrollable form with category selector pills, multiline question input, 4 option rows with correct-answer radio toggles, media upload picker, and sticky bottom Publish CTA.

screens.name: Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Display user ranking progress based on the 25-correct-answers-per-1-point rule and active tier ranks.

states.loading: Shimmer rows simulating top user ranks.
states.empty: Encouraging state inviting users to answer their first 25 questions to earn their rank.
states.error: Failed to load leaderboard message with retry button.

screens.layout: Header featuring user's current rank card and progress towards the next point (e.g. 18/25 correct), followed by a ranked list of top learners with avatar, username, points, and correct answer counts.

screens.name: ChatInbox
screens.purpose: List direct messages and friend connections for chatting and sharing interesting questions directly.

states.empty: Friendly illustration with button to discover and add friends.
states.error: Network error banner with reconnect button.

screens.layout: Conversations list with search bar, online status avatars, unread badges, and quick tap to open chat or share shared questions.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Showcase user statistics, earned points, rank, saved questions, and authored trivia posts.

states.loading: Profile header skeleton with tab placeholders.
states.empty: No saved questions or posts yet message with CTA to explore feed.
states.error: Error loading profile data with retry button.

screens.layout: Profile header with avatar, bio, total points, rank badge, tab selector (My Posts, Saved Questions, Stats), and grid/list of user content.

hero_learning.alt: Students learning collaboratively with vibrant backdrop

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Swipedia as a Tactile/Playful Light mobile app using Expo, React Native Reanimated, and Gorhom Bottom Sheet.
Ensure the core Explore feed is a vertical swipeable TikTok-style quiz experience where every 25 correct answers yields 1 point.
Include fully interactive multiple-choice quiz tiles with instant tactile feedback (success/error state animations).
Build bottom sheet modals for comments, bookmarking, and share-to-friends messaging.
Include Google and Email/Password authentication entry points with demo guest mode access.
Adhere strictly to the Spacing, Layout, Glassmorphism, and Typography rules specified in design guidelines.
